good.stone.name: Stone
good.stone.desc: Rough blocks cut from the hills, for walls that outlast their builders.
good.apples.name: Apples
good.apples.desc: Crisp orchard fruit, good eating and better pressing.
good.cider.name: Cider
good.cider.desc: Pressed and mellowed apple cider, the village's comfort at day's end.
good.clay.name: Clay
good.clay.desc: Sticky riverbank clay, dug for pots and bricks.
good.pottery.name: Pottery
good.pottery.desc: Fired earthenware bowls and jars for every household.
building.quarry.name: Quarry
building.quarry.desc: Quarrymen cut stone from the hills above the town.
building.clay_pit.name: Clay Pit
building.clay_pit.desc: Diggers lift clay from the riverbanks, where the river leaves it.
building.potters_kiln.name: Potter's Kiln
building.potters_kiln.desc: Potters shape clay and firewood into sturdy earthenware.
building.orchard.name: Orchard
building.orchard.desc: Rows of apple trees: the richer the soil, the heavier the harvest.
building.cider_press.name: Cider Press
building.cider_press.desc: A heavy screw press turns the orchard's apples into cider.
building.scouts_lodge.name: Scout's Lodge
building.scouts_lodge.desc: Scouts rest here between expeditions into the unknown parts of the island.
building.timber_bridge.name: Timber Bridge
building.timber_bridge.desc: A wooden bridge that carries a road across a narrow river.
building.plaza.name: Plaza
building.plaza.desc: A paved square where neighbours meet and linger.
building.cobbled_road.name: Cobbled Road
building.cobbled_road.desc: Setts of stone that speed carts on their way.
building.stone_storehouse.name: Stone Storehouse
building.stone_storehouse.desc: A stone storehouse: it keeps goods longer and sends out an extra cart.
building.stone_shrine.name: Stone Shrine
building.stone_shrine.desc: A shrine rebuilt in stone, where more neighbours gather and rest.
building.rotation_farm.name: Rotation Farm
building.rotation_farm.desc: Farmers rest each field in turn, so fewer hands grow the same grain.
building.fish_weir.name: Fish Weir
building.fish_weir.desc: A woven tidal trap that fishes the shallows while its keepers mend nets.
building.communal_oven.name: Communal Oven
building.communal_oven.desc: One great oven bakes the village's bread with fewer bakers.
recipe.quarry_stone.name: Quarry stone
recipe.quarry_stone.desc: Cut blocks of stone from the hillside.
recipe.dig_clay.name: Dig clay
recipe.dig_clay.desc: Lift sticky clay from the riverbanks.
recipe.fire_pottery.name: Fire pottery
recipe.fire_pottery.desc: Shape clay and fire it with wood into earthenware.
recipe.grow_apples.name: Grow apples
recipe.grow_apples.desc: Tend the orchard rows and gather the harvest.
recipe.press_cider.name: Press cider
recipe.press_cider.desc: Press apples into cider and leave it to mellow.
